records.prompt: Create a replacement together-fall death animation for the approved Late Medieval Russian Cossack Rider in reference. Transparent sprite atlas 1536x1024, EXACTLY SIX consecutive frames in THREE columns TWO rows. Each 512x512 cell has the entire horse, rider and lance inside with 40px clear margins. Same painted art, palette, proportions, light iron lamellar vest and shoulder caps over black coat, blue trousers, red-crowned black fur cap, unarmored bay horse with black mane/tail and gray saddle roll. Lance right hand screen-left, reins left. Strict overhead camera fixed throughout; no perspective change. Motion: 1 upright mounted rest facing bottom; 2 front legs buckle, horse drops chest downward, rider pitches with it; 3 horse rolls onto its LEFT flank, rider loses seat but stays immediately beside saddle; 4 horse fully lands on flank, four anatomically correct legs extended sideways, rider tumbles down alongside horse; 5 settle rider flat alongside saddle and horse motionless on side; 6 same corpse orientation with only tiny settling, no inversion, no rotation reversal. Horse nose remains directed mostly toward bottom throughout; its body axis remains tail top/head bottom, falling sideways is a roll not a 90-degree turn in the ground plane. Final rider clearly lying on ground beside horse, NOT still sitting upright astride a sideways horse. No rider thrown through air, no blood, no armor added to horse, no extra limbs, no missing lance, no background/shadow/outline/grain/text. Leave generous separation between cells.
